name: Laien Parts Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Laien Parts Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, processing, engineering, management, and sales of industrial piping in Taiwan and the United States. The company offers piping systems, ultrasonic equipment, and solar power plants. It also supplies electronic-grade valves and equipment consumables; and manufactures and sells semiconductor equipment-related components. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
